cues.zh: 和初代型号相比，体积减半、重量略低于一半，电池续航翻倍。这本来才应该是他们最初推出的机器。如果你愿意放弃录音功能、只要一台MiniDisc播放器，那就可以选择MZ-E2。它同样于1993年推出。

cues.en: And it looks a lot more like the mini disc machines we became accustomed to later in the format's life.
cues.zh: 它看起来更像是该格式后期我们习以为常的迷你光盘机。

cues.en: Okay. So let's talk a little bit more about the makeup of a mini disc itself. So on the left, we've a standard 12 centimeter CD album.
cues.zh: 好，那我们再多聊聊迷你光盘本身的构成。左边是一张标准的12厘米CD专辑。

cues.en: On the right is a 6.4
cues.zh: 右边是一张6.4

cues.en: centimeter mini disc inside its case. Now, of course, don't remove it from the case at any point. It's played inside this, so the reason it's in the case is to protect it from getting damaged because it's a portable format. It's no more easy to damage than a compact disc. It's just the kind of thing that you might be carrying around with you in a bag and you don't want any keys scratching and things. Now, the plastic case for this is quite similar to the one you get on a three and a half inch floppy disc, and of course, that was also developed by Sony.
cues.zh: 厘米的迷你光盘，装在它的盒子里。当然，任何时候都不要把它从盒子里取出来。它就在这个盒子里播放，放在盒子里是为了防止损坏，因为它是便携格式。它并不比CD更容易损坏。只是这类东西你可能会装在包里随身携带，不想让钥匙刮到之类的。这个塑料盒和3.5英寸软盘的盒子很相似，当然，那也是索尼开发的。

cues.en: Now, before you can get in here, you've got to unlock this. There's a little catch here which is holding the door shut, which is a good idea. Again, it won't just slide open in your pocket.
cues.zh: 现在，你得先解锁才能打开这里。这里有个小卡扣把门关住，这设计不错。同样，它不会在你口袋里自己滑开。

cues.en: Now, unlike a floppy disk, that door isn't spring loaded. It automatically closes once you remove it from the machine. So it's normally only open inside the machine which then gives it access to the top as well as the bottom of the disc which is important for reasons I'll go into in a moment. But before I get to that, I just wanna clear something else up. I do get quite a few emails from people that get mixed up over the difference between a mini CD, a UMD,
cues.zh: 和软盘不同，那扇门不是弹簧加载的。你把它从机器里取出来时，它会自动关上。所以通常只在机器内部才打开，这样机器就能接触到光盘的顶部和底部，这很重要，原因我稍后会讲。但在那之前，我想先澄清另一件事。我确实收到不少邮件，人们搞混了迷你CD、UMD

cues.en: and a mini disc. They are three entirely
cues.zh: 和迷你光盘的区别。它们是三种完全

cues.en: formats from one another and they're also different sizes as well. If I remove them from their cases which is something you wouldn't normally do, we can see that in decreasing order of size we go from a mini CD
cues.zh: 不同的格式，尺寸也各不相同。如果我把它们从盒子里取出来——通常你不会这么做——可以看到按尺寸递减的顺序，从迷你CD

cues.en: which is eight centimeters in diameter to a mini disc which is 6.4
cues.zh: 直径8厘米，到迷你光盘6.4

cues.en: to a UMD which is six centimeters.
cues.zh: 再到UMD，6厘米。

cues.en: And on top of that, I hear from quite a few people that think their GameCube games came on mini CDs but they didn't. They were mini DVDs although they are the same size disc. Anyway, back to mini disc now. So all mini disc machines used an electronic memory buffer. So it read data off the disc, stored it in the buffer and you listened to it from there. Which meant that you could shake a mini disc player around as and long as you didn't do it for too long, you wouldn't have any interruption in your music. There wouldn't be any skipping. There was a ten second buffer in the early machines. It varied depending on the play mode as well and in the later machines, got quite a bit longer. Now, this was a technology that moved across to personal CD players in about '95.
cues.zh: 除此之外，我还听不少人说他们的GameCube游戏是装在迷你CD上的，但其实不是。它们是迷你DVD，虽然光盘尺寸一样。好了，现在回到迷你光盘。所有迷你光盘机都使用了电子内存缓冲区。它从光盘读取数据，存到缓冲区里，你听到的就是缓冲区里的内容。这意味着你可以随意晃动迷你光盘播放器，只要晃的时间不太长，音乐就不会中断。不会有跳音。早期的机器有十秒缓冲区。它还随播放模式而变化，后来的机器缓冲区长了不少。这项技术在95年左右被移植到了便携式CD播放器上。

cues.en: So actually started off in all mini disc players and then moved to CD portables
cues.zh: 所以实际上它最早出现在所有迷你光盘播放器上，然后才

cues.en: later on.
cues.zh: 后来转移到便携CD上。

cues.zh: 当然，迷你光盘的主要特点之一是它是一种可录介质。单看价格，它算是个先驱。回到1992年的上市价格，第一台迷你光盘录音机在美国卖750美元

cues.en: in The US.
If you'd bought a CD writer at that time, it would have cost you $10,000.
cues.zh: 那时候你要买一台CD刻录机，得花你一万美元。

cues.en: It was only 1995 when they came down below 1,000
cues.zh: 直到1995年，CD刻录机的价格才降到1000美元以下

cues.en: for a CD writer. Now CD rewriters only turned up on the scene in 1997.
cues.zh: 。而CD可重写刻录机1997年才出现。

cues.en: So bear in mind, mini disc was rewritable back in 1992.
cues.zh: 所以别忘了，迷你光盘在1992年就已经可重写了。

cues.en: You could rewrite on a mini disc it says apparently up to a million times.
cues.zh: 据称，MiniDisc 可以擦写多达一百万次。

cues.en: When it comes to reading a pre recorded mini disc, it's read in much the same way as a compact disc works. You've got a laser underneath that reads the data off the disc. However, when it comes to writing on a mini disc, it's a different story. Those discs are magneto
cues.zh: 说到读取预录制的 MiniDisc，其原理和光盘差不多。盘片下方有一个激光头用来读取盘上的数据。然而，如果要往 MiniDisc 上写入数据，情况就完全不同了。这些盘片是磁光盘。

cues.en: optical.
And what that means is, the data is actually written by a magnetic record head that goes on the top of the disc
cues.zh: 这意味着，数据实际上是通过位于盘片上方的磁性记录头来写入的，

cues.en: and the data is then read back later using the laser from below. But the laser is also used in conjunction with the recording process because before the disc is recorded on, the laser heats the disc up to the Curie point 200 degrees C, which wipes out the data ready for the new data to be written.
cues.zh: 随后再用下方的激光头将数据读取出来。不过，激光头也会参与到记录过程中：在向盘片写入数据之前，激光会把盘片加热到 200 摄氏度的居里点，从而擦除原有数据，为写入新数据做好准备。

cues.en: So to give you an idea of what this mechanism looks like inside a real mini disc, well, I mean, bought this broken model off eBay. I bought a number of different mini disc machines to make this video. In fact, I only had one when I start, and I've got half a dozen there. But let's have a look inside this one. It's gonna be quite easy to take apart because we just need to take four screws out of the top, and hopefully then we'll be able to see exactly how this all fits together.
cues.zh: 为了让大家直观了解真实 MiniDisc 内部的这个机械结构是什么样的，嗯，我从 eBay 上买了这个坏掉的样机。为了做这期视频，我买了好几台不同的 MiniDisc 机器。事实上，刚开始我只有一台，现在旁边已经堆了半打。不过我们先来看看这台机器的内部。拆解会相当简单，因为我们只需要拧掉顶部的四颗螺丝，希望接下来就能看清这一切是如何组合在一起的。

cues.en: Okay. So there we go. We've got a laser at the bottom, the lens that you can see there, which will read the underneath of the disc, and then on top, we've got this part here. And if we move it along, we'll see that these things both travel along together with each other. So they move along the disc at the same point.
cues.zh: 好。就这样。我们能在底部看到一个激光头和透镜，用来读取盘片底部；而在顶部，则是这个部件。如果我们把它拨动一下，就会发现这两个部件是同步移动的。它们会在盘片上的相同位置一起移动。

cues.en: And of course that part on the top is the record head we mentioned. If we tip that up, can see that it's just a little square there. Not much to see at all. But we can see that as we put a disc into this machine where it all fits together, the door slides open, record head goes on the top, and of course, the laser remains underneath.
cues.zh: 当然，上面这部分就是我们提过的录音磁头。如果我们把它翻起来，可以看到它只是个小方块。其实没什么特别的。但当我们把一张碟片放进机器时，就能看清它们是如何组合在一起的：仓门滑开，录音磁头落在上方，而激光头自然还是在下方。

cues.en: And if you were wondering whether a magnet could damage a mini disc recording, the answer is no. Well, not unless you heat the mini disc to 200 degrees at the same time. From the word go, this was advertised very much as a format that you'd use for recording onto. So you'd have your existing album on say a compact disc and you'd dub it across to a blank mini disc so you could take it with you in a more convenient format.
cues.zh: 如果你好奇磁铁会不会损坏 MiniDisc 里的录音，答案是不会。呃，除非你同时把 MiniDisc 加热到 200 度。从一开始，它的宣传重点就是一种用来自己录制的格式。比如你可以把你现有的 CD 专辑转录到一张空白的 MiniDisc 上，这样就能以一种更便携的形式随身带着听了。

cues.en: Very little emphasis was placed on the idea of buying pre recorded mini discs. Although they did exist, they were very hard to find. I used to frequent the record shops everywhere I went to. The only place I ever saw them was in the Virgin Megastore, the flagship store on Oxford Street in London. And even then, they were just on a little shelf in the corner. There were a few titles. I bought one for the missus because it was the first time I'd seen them. Was a bit of a novelty. And it was George Michael's Ladies and Gentlemen, which is a double album and it cost me £25,
cues.zh: 官方当时几乎完全不主推购买现成的预录 MiniDisc。虽然确实有卖，但极难买到。我以前不管去哪儿都爱逛唱片店。我唯一见过它们的地方，就是伦敦牛津街上的 Virgin Megastore 旗舰店。即便在那儿，它们也只是被放在角落的一个小架子上。就那么几张。我给太太买了一张，因为那是我第一次见到，图个新鲜。买的是 George Michael 的双碟专辑《Ladies and Gentlemen》，花了我 25 英镑，

I was wondering whether these were more of a thing in Japan, but after I've recently looked through the Japanese auctions online, there are very few for sale there either. cues.zh: 这当然比对应的 CD 贵多了。我之前还在想这东西在日本会不会更流行一些，但最近在网上的日本拍卖网站上搜了一圈后，发现那儿卖的也非常少。所以我觉得它可能在欧洲才是巅峰期，即便在欧洲，买的人也是寥寥无几。大部分发行的专辑也都来自 Sony 旗下的自家厂牌。

cues.en: So we're talking about people like Columbia and Epic and I mentioned in the DAT video that Sony bought music labels so they at least have something to release on their own formats.
cues.zh: 所以我们说的是 Columbia 和 Epic 这样的公司，我在 DAT 视频里提到过，Sony 收购了唱片公司，这样他们至少有些内容可以在自己的格式上发行。

cues.en: But if you are looking for a reason to get a pre recorded mini disc back in the day, there are a couple. You get the nice box. You get the booklet at the front. You get the album art. And of course, you get the track data,
cues.zh: 但如果你当年想找个理由买预录 MiniDisc，还是有几个理由的。你能得到漂亮的盒子，前面有册子，有专辑封面，当然还有曲目数据，

cues.en: which would also be stored on there and would display alongside the music as it was playing on your machine.
cues.zh: 这些数据也会存在光盘上，并在你的机器播放音乐时随音乐一起显示。

cues.en: Notice on this side of the disc, we've got a sticker that covers the whole side, and when you compare that to the blank disc,
cues.zh: 注意光盘这一面有一张贴纸覆盖了整个面，而和空白盘对比时，

cues.en: you can only put a sticker on about half that because it needs access to the top of the disc to be able to record onto it. The pre recorded ones are not magneto optical discs. They're just normal optical discs. So they only need access from below for the laser to read the data.
cues.zh: 空白盘只能贴大约一半，因为它需要接触光盘顶部才能录制。预录盘不是磁光盘，它们只是普通光盘，所以只需要从下方让激光读取数据。

cues.en: This is the most recent mini disc album that I own. It's from 1999
cues.zh: 这是我拥有的最新的 MiniDisc 专辑，来自 1999 年

cues.en: and it's a compilation on the left. We've got the two MD version on the right, the two compact cassette edition. I haven't bought too many pre recorded mini discs for a few reasons. One of which is that there's not many titles that appeal to me. The next one is people say that the sound quality on them isn't as good as if you'd have done it yourself.
cues.zh: 左边是一张合辑。右边我们有双 MD 版本，两张 compact cassette 版。我买过的预录 MiniDisc 不多，有几个原因。其中一个是我感兴趣的标题不多。另一个是人们说它们的音质不如你自己录的。

cues.en: And thirdly, the prices on them are astronomical.
cues.zh: 第三点，它们的价格简直是天文数字。

cues.en: There's some ridiculous prices out there because of the rarity, I suppose, of some of these titles. They've now entered into the world of the collector's market where all logic and reasoning goes out of the window.
cues.zh: 我想是因为某些专辑的稀有度，市面上出现了一些离谱的高价。它们现在已经进入了收藏品市场，而在那里，一切逻辑和常理全都不管用了。

cues.en: So rather than just buying the best quality you could as a lossless file or as a CD, you could spend 10 times that amount to get it on a mini disc.
cues.zh: 所以与其买音质最好的无损音频文件或 CD，你反而可能要花上 10 倍的价钱去买一张 MiniDisc。

cues.zh: 好，接下来我们聊聊你能买到的各种 MiniDisc 录音机和设备。要是没有 minidisc.org 的帮助，这一部分内容根本不可能做出来。

cues.zh: 那是一个能查到关于 MiniDisc 所有你想了解的信息的网站。它已经有一阵子没更新了，不过话又说回来，MiniDisc 本身也没更新过，所以你也没错过什么。上面有个特别好用的功能是设备浏览器，能直接看到当年一共推出了多少种设备。我开头提到的那些数据就是从这里来的。有 26 款 Hi-MD 设备，140 款

cues.zh: 座机，也就是家用机型，一共有 129 款。看看这些数据，再看看这些厂商。在大约 14 年的时间里，他们推出了这么多不同的机器。如果这产品真像现在人们描绘得那么失败，厂商绝不可能在 14 年里推出 30 款不同的机器。他们可能推出一两款，然后就直接放弃了。

I'm not entirely sure, but I found out it came from 2000 by looking on the minidisc.org
cues.zh: 虽然我从一开始就对 MiniDisc 很感兴趣，但直到 2000 年才买了第一台机器，就是这台。它的包装盒还在，但机器已经不知道去哪了。我可能把它卖给别人了。我也记不太清，但我去查了 minidisc.org 上的

cues.en: page
cues.zh: 页面

cues.en: about it at the end of 2000. I remember buying it when was brand new out, that was because it was the smallest machine available,
cues.zh: 那是 2000 年底的介绍。我记得刚上市我就买了，主要是因为它是当时市面上最小的一款，

cues.zh: 而且它还支持 MDLP，

MDLP was introduced with a new version of the eight track codec, which enabled the mini disc to record at lower bit rates with the same or similar sound quality. cues.zh: 这是当时刚推出的新特性。所以 2000 到 2001 年对 MiniDisc 来说是个很重要的阶段。它又开始重新出现在英国的货架上。MDLP 伴随着新版 ATRAC 编解码器推出，让 MiniDisc 能在音质相同或相近的情况下以更低的码率录制。LP2 能让单张盘片的录音时长翻倍，LP4 则是四倍。我觉得 LP4 对音质损伤太大，不太喜欢。不过 LP2 我几乎听不出什么区别，所以我自己录大部分盘都是用的这个模式。

cues.zh: 第二年，Sony 推出了 NetMD

cues.zh: 你可以把电脑里的文件导出来，不管是抓轨的 CD 还是 MP3，
